name: Cadaverous Guar

abilities.name: Belch of Bile
abilities.description: The guar spits many poison pools in front of itself as indicated by red circles. It will usually do this after reviving.

abilities.name: Spit
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that does minor poison damage.

related_quests: Casting the Bones: Investigate a necromancer cult searching for a long-dead Dragon.
Pledge: Fang Lair: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Fang Lair.
summary: The Cadaverous Guar is a large skeletal guar found in Fang Lair alongside the Cadaverous Bear, Senche-Tiger, it makes up the Cadaverous Menagerie, the second boss fight of the dungeon. Additionally it will be supported by Cadaverous Dire Wolves.
